theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_att_mem_range_of_secant_blowUp
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (x w : Euclid P) (A : Euclid d →L[ℝ] Euclid P), (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ N, dist y x < δ → ∃ a : Euclid d, ‖y - x - A a‖ ≤ ε * ‖y - x‖) → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∃ lam₀ : ℝ, 0 < lam₀ ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam < lam₀ → ∃ y ∈ N, ‖lam⁻¹ • (y - x) - w‖ < s) → w ∈ Set.range A
